equipment_type: Dynamic control valve with energy metering
applies_to: Siemens Intelligent Valve families EVG4/EXG4 (DN 15-50) and EVF4/EXF4 (DN 65-125, plus a DN 150 version) with the ASE4U10E or ASE4U10A controller.
summary: The Intelligent Valve is a hydronic control valve with a built-in flow sensor and temperature inputs, so it reports flow, power, energy and operating statistics. It talks BACnet IP (Modbus RTU runs in parallel) and can run as a dynamic control valve, a changeover valve, a flow temperature controller, a heating circuit controller or a differential pressure controller. Over BACnet IP the valve follows SpRel (AV 16), a 0-100 % setpoint that becomes a position, flow or power setpoint depending on CtlMod (MV 39).
notes: One object list covers every control function (dynamic control valve, changeover, flow temperature, heating circuit, differential pressure); the guide marks which objects each function uses. This file lists every object ID printed in the Operation, Balancing and Commissioning chapters.

Some objects have a second instance in the differential pressure (Δp) function, and some analog inputs and outputs change instance with the selected signal type; each printed ID is listed with the same object name.
Heating circuit and room heating objects are only active when the flow temperature control or heating circuit application is selected.

Printed IDs kept as listed, with these exceptions: PrAdaPwrMax is printed 'AVI162' (listed as AV 162); ROpModSched is printed 'Schedule 1'; DrygFnctSta is printed both as MSV87 and AV87, and AV87 is also SbstTR, so only MV 87 is kept; TnHcrTFlVlvCtr (a reset time in seconds) is printed as MSV86, which is DrygFnct's ID, so its real ID is unknown and it is left out.
Units are metric as printed (°C, m³/h, kW, kPa). Access is W where the guide's Write column says Y. Modbus register addresses are not reproduced.

integration.summary: Commission the valve as a dynamic control valve with the setpoint coming over BACnet IP, so PrSpSrc (MV 54) reads 3. The BMS then writes SpRel (AV 16) and reads flow, power, the primary temperatures, valve position and the main fault code MnFlt (MV 57). The guide's own short list for integration also includes the present flow and power setpoints and the control state.

minimum_points.name: PrSpSrc
minimum_points.why: Must read 3 (Relative setpoint remote) for BACnet IP

integration.enable: The application and setpoint source are set at commissioning; PrSpSrc (MV 54) shows the result. Option 3 (Relative setpoint remote) means the dynamic control valve takes SpRel (AV 16) from BACnet IP; options 7 and 8 do the same for flow temperature and differential pressure setpoints. VovrMod (MV 92) can override the valve (fully open, fully closed, minimum or maximum flow and so on).
integration.heartbeat: BckpMod (MV 42) sets what the valve does when its setpoint is missing, for example when no remote setpoint is present: None (default), Last setpoint, or Predefined setpoint from AV 34-36. BckpModDly (PIV 0, seconds) is the delay before backup mode starts. Backup mode applies to the dynamic control valve and flow temperature applications only.
setup: BACnet IP per Annex J; the device has no BBMD function.

Modbus RTU on port 1 runs alongside BACnet IP: address PIV 14 (default 10), baud MV 93 (default 19200), stop bits MV 94, parity MV 95 (default Even); write MbPort1SetApy (MV 96) = 2 (Apply) to use new settings.
CtlMod (MV 39) picks position, volume flow or power control; VflMax (AV 22) and PwrMax (AV 27) scale SpRel into the flow or power setpoint.
gotchas: SpTFl (flow temperature setpoint) has a priority array; priority 15 is used by the internal control, so the guide recommends commanding it at priority 14.
In the differential pressure function several objects move to other instances (for example CtlSta MV 63, PrVfl AV 70, PrPwr AV 71); map the right set for the function in use.
Pressure, flow temperature and outside temperature inputs change instance with the selected signal type; check which ID is live on the device.
Alarm BVs (Alm1004-Alm3050) print state 0 = Active and 1 = Inactive.
